symptom: MDL-WIDGET15 (adjacent inline dynamic texts concatenate, 'both <span>') was raised on a native page, where each dynamic text is its own React Native Text element (ako/mxcli#2562, mendixlabs/mxcli#1933).
cause: The rule runs in the per-statement widget pass, which has no project and does not know the page's platform; nothing scoped its HTML-based reasoning to web pages.
fix: ValidateProgram drops the web-only notes (MDL-WIDGET15) for a page whose layout resolves as native, from the script or the project (layoutPlatformResolver, the same resolver MDL-WIDGET55 uses); a page whose layout does not resolve keeps them.
insight: Unmeasured native rendering is a reason to stop claiming, not to claim the opposite: the note is dropped on native rather than rewritten. A rule whose message names a client technology (<span>, CSS) is scoped to that client — grep the message for it when adding native support.
test: mdl/executor/validate_dynamictext_native_2562_test.go (native layout from the script and from PedApp: none; unresolved and web controls: one); failed before the filter; live: check -p on TestApp notes only the web page
